workspace.title: Bank imports
workspace.descriptionText: Turn bank statements into reviewed cash-flow entries, with a clear record of every import.
workspace.uploadDescription: Choose the source account and upload one statement. Review every transaction before creating entries.
workspace.noBanks: No active bank accounts available. Add an account in Settings or ask an administrator for access.
workspace.bankError: Bank accounts could not be loaded.
workspace.fileError: Choose PDF, CSV, OFX or XML up to 20 MB, or PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 10 MB.
workspace.drop: Drop your statement here, or choose a file
workspace.formats: PDF, CSV, OFX, XML · 20 MB / PNG, JPEG, WebP · 10 MB
workspace.error: The import could not be completed. Your saved review is preserved.
workspace.structuredText: CSV and OFX are read without AI. Clear PDFs work best when structured files are unavailable.
workspace.reviewText: Suggestions help categorize transactions. You decide what becomes an entry. Importing does not settle entries or create future installments.
workspace.empty: No imports yet. Upload a bank statement to get started.
workspace.readingHelp: Reading your statement. This may take a few minutes for scanned documents.
workspace.matchingHelp: Finding matches in your confirmed history and preparing suggestions.
workspace.resumeHelp: You can leave this page and return from import history. Processing and saved choices are retained.
workspace.familyHelp: Copies category, entity and other classification details to matching installments in this statement. Dates and amounts remain individual. No future installments are generated.
workspace.required: Provide a description, date, positive amount, direction and category. Use at most two decimal places.
workspace.duplicateWarning: A similar transaction exists in your history or elsewhere in this statement. Check the source before including it.
workspace.discard: Discard unsaved changes to this transaction?
workspace.completedHelp: The source document is retained with your import history. Created entries are available in Cash flow.
workspace.reviewHelp: Check dates, amounts and categories. Review or exclude every pending transaction before creating entries. Suggestions are never posted automatically.
workspace.savedHelp: Reviews are saved when you confirm a transaction. Bulk actions apply only to the selected rows. Possible duplicates are retained for your decision.
workspace.confirm: Create {{count}} cash-flow entries? This imports only the reviewed transactions, without settling them or generating future installments.
workspace.noPermission: You do not have permission to create or prepare imports.
workspace.suggestionsUnavailable: AI suggestions are temporarily unavailable. Your transactions were read successfully; you can review and categorize them manually.
workspace.processingDelay: Processing is taking longer than expected. Try again to resume, or return later from import history.
